title: Icelandic long-term visa for remote work (closed)

sources.title: Regulation No. 725/2026 amending Regulation No. 540/2017 on foreign nationals, art. 1: chapter II now covers only short-term residence permits, with no ground for remote work
Visa Act No. 37/2026, art. 23(1)(c) and (d): art. 20 of the Foreign Nationals Act No. 80/2016 repealed and art. 21 replaced by the short-term residence permit
Regulation No. 1048/2020 amending Regulation No. 540/2017, art. 2: the former art. 5 a, a long-term visa of up to 180 days for remote work
Act No. 15/2005 on the official gazette, art. 8(2): published rules bind from the day after the gazette's publication date
